name: NPC Teleporter
description: Teleporter NPCs in capitals (entry 190000) and starting zones (190001).

sql.note: upstream sets @ONY_LEVEL := 60 at line 18 and uses it in one row (line 189); the step below writes the answer into that row, so the clone stays unmodified

sql.statement: UPDATE conditions SET ConditionValue1={ony_level} WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId=15 AND SourceGroup=50004 AND SourceEntry=11 AND ConditionTypeOrReference=27;
sql.note: T104: the Onyxia portal's level requirement, the one row teleporter_capital.dist builds from @ONY_LEVEL (upstream @06e5242: `(15, @GOSSIP_MENU+4, 11, 27, @ONY_LEVEL, 3, 0, ...)` with @GOSSIP_MENU := 50000)

sql.statement: DELETE FROM creature WHERE id IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template WHERE entry IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template_model WHERE CreatureID IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM creature_template_addon WHERE entry IN (190000,190001); DELETE FROM gossip_menu WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 50000 AND 50017; DELETE FROM gossip_menu_option WHERE MenuID BETWEEN 50000 AND 50017; DELETE FROM npc_text WHERE ID BETWEEN 300000 AND 300009; DELETE FROM smart_scripts WHERE entryorguid IN (190000,190001) AND source_type = 0; DELETE FROM conditions WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup BETWEEN 50000 AND 50017; DELETE FROM gameobject WHERE id = 194394 AND guid >= 200000;
sql.note: T558: `creature.id`, not `id1`: AzerothCore's 2026_06_16_00.sql renamed id1 to id and dropped id2/id3, and every WotLK pin Yu'lon has shipped carries it (tests/test_wotlk_world_columns.py); T560: also the rows the two .dist files DELETE before they INSERT (their @GOSSIP_MENU 50000..50009 and 50009..50017, @TEXT_ID 300000..300005 and 300005..300009, the capital file's rune gameobject 194394 from guid 200000), so Remove leaves the world as it was

prompts.question: Level needed for the Onyxia's Lair teleport (60 for classic content, 80 for WotLK)

notes: Both NPCs are always installed. Originally by Rochet2.
